orders.text:
WPMS No.3651 of 2018
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
(via Video Conferencing)
Mr. Piyush Garg, Advocate for the petitioners.
Mr. Neeraj Garg, Advocate for the respondents.
By virtue of the counter affidavit filed by the 
respondents, an averment was made therein that 
respondent nos.2, 8, 11 and 14 have met with the sad 
demise. Consequently, the counsel for the petitioner by 
an order dated 18.02.2020, was directed to do the 
needful; but till date no steps have been taken by the 
petitioner nor any substitution application, as 
permissible under the law has been preferred. 
The matter is listed today on an Abatement 
Application No.9229 of 2020; as well as Urgency 
Application No.10501 of 2020, which has been
preferred by the respondents for dismissing the writ 
petition as having abated, as well as on urgency 
application.
Owing to the fact that in spite of the sufficient 
time being granted since 18.02.2020, no substitution 
application has been filed. The writ petition would be 
treated to have been dismissed as abated qua the 
deceased respondent nos.2, 8, 11 and 14. Accordingly, 
the abatement application is disposed of. 
So far as the urgency application is concerned,
the writ petition is directed to be listed in the last week 
of November, 2020. 
Interim order already granted is extended till 
next date of listing. 
 
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
 31.10.2020

Hon’ble Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.
Mr. Naitik Bhatt, proxy counsel for Mr. Piyush Garg, 
counsel for the petitioner.
2. Mr. Neeraj Garg, counsel for respondent nos. 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 
7, 10, 12 & 13, 15, 16 & 17.
3. A Recall Application (IA 11243 of 2020) along with delay 
condonation application (IA 11244 of 2020) has been filed by 
the petitioner to recall the order dated 31.10.2020, whereby the 
present writ petition was dismissed as abated qua the deceased 
respondent nos. 2, 8, 11 & 14.
Counsel for the petitioner would submit that the 
respondent nos. 2,8 & 14 passed away prior to the filing of the 
writ petition; that, only respondent no.11 has expired on 
08.06.2019 during the pendency of the present petition, 
therefore, the order dated 31.10.2020 is liable to be recalled 
against the respondent nos. 2, 8 & 14. 
4. Counsel for the respondent has no objection if the Recall 
Application as well delay condonation application is allowed.
5. Recall application as well delay condonation application 
are accordingly allowed. Order dated 31.10.2020 is hereby 
recalled.
6. Re-issue notices to the proposed legal heirs of 
respondent nos. 2, 8 & 14 on the impleadment application (IA 
11268 of 2020) through ordinary process and registered post 
acknowledgment due as well as through e-mail and whatsapp, 
if available. 
7. Steps to be taken within two weeks.
8. List this case on 23.08.2024.
9 Urgency application (IA 18772 of 2024) stands 
disposed of accordingly. 
(Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.) 
 01.05.2024
Mamta
